svg.text: Option: VCF Operations Continuous Availability across the two instances
When the DCI stays under 10 ms RTT, the Ops cluster can be split into two fault domains on the stretched segment, with a witness in a third site
seg-vcf-mgmt · stretched overlay segment · CA nodes must share one VLAN / IP subnet across both fault domains
every object on one node per FD
Ops for Networks: still vSphere Replication (not covered by CA)
witness ↔ each fault domain ≤ 30 ms RTT
tie-breaker only: decides which fault domain stays online on a split

VCF Operations never fails over: lose a site and the surviving fault domain keeps serving. No recovery plan for Ops, no RPO on Ops data, no re-IP. Price: double the Ops nodes, a third site for the witness, and a DCI that stays under 10 ms RTT.
Everything else in the runbook is unchanged: Network Recovery on the Global Manager, Ops for Networks via replication, Automation and the management services from backup.
